text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Triumphant in the Shuka Sho, Hishi Amazon 
splendidly achieved the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the post-race press conference, Hishi 
Amazon smiles and says she made it this 
far thanks to her Trainer, the best 
partner she could ask for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she issues a declaration of war to 
Narita Brian, challenging her to a 
one-on-one duel at the next Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the broadcast, Narita Brian 
smirked fearlessly to herself—
